title: Server fetches of user-provided image and crawl URLs resolve DNS and block private addresses
detail:
fetchRemoteImage has no guard on a public route; lib/ai/web/index.ts:118 and lib/importer/harvest/media.ts:67 check hostnames only and follow redirects. Reuse the pinned fetch from lib/qr/remote-logo.ts (#3919). Also extend the private range list (192.0.0.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15, NAT64, 6to4).

2026-10-26 REPAIR LANDED as SEC-010 (#3932): lib/net/pinned-fetch.ts (shared pinned fetch) now backs the OG image fetch, the crawler and importer media, verified by scripts/probes/sec-ssrf-pinned-fetch.mjs. This row's probe looks for remote-logo, isPrivateIp or assertPublic in remote-image.ts, which the shared module does not use. The repair is done; the probe is unchanged and still fails, so this row stays open until Daniel rules on replacing it or the probe is re-pointed.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
